zh-TW.title: 1.7.0 有什麼新功能
highlights: 可以調整課表與主畫面小工具中的課名字型大小。
App Store 上推出新版本時，會在 App 內提醒你更新。
升級後首次開啟會顯示這個「新功能」說明。

en.title: What's new in 1.7.0
highlights: Resize course names in the class table and home-screen widgets.
We'll let you know when a new release is ready on the App Store.
After upgrading, this 'What's new' summary appears on first launch.

en.title: What's new in 1.8.0
highlights: Bulletin push notifications, with a switch in Settings to turn them off.
The app offers to update itself, and shows what changed once you install.
Flip your phone face-down to bring up your library QR code.
Passwords and the library QR are now hidden from screenshots and screen recordings.

zh-TW.title: 1.8.0 更新內容
highlights: 公告推播通知，可在設定中隨時關閉。
有新版本時會主動提醒，更新後告訴你這一版改了什麼。
手機翻面朝下即可叫出圖書證 QR Code。
密碼與圖書證 QR 在截圖和螢幕錄影中會自動遮蔽。

zh-TW.title: 2.0.0 更新內容
highlights: 雲端同步正式上線：課表、作業、課程顏色與自訂課名會在 iPhone 與 Mac 之間即時同步。
重設課表可只重設目前學期；仍缺教室的課程會在重新整理時補查。
歷年成績頁載入更快，尚未有排名的學期會先顯示預估 GPA。
首頁勾選完成作業後課表標記立即更新；時光機在衝堂時也能正常拖曳。
Apple Watch 的圖書證 QR Code 改由 iPhone 取得，不再容易過期。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.0
highlights: Cloud sync is live: your class table, assignments, course colours and custom names stay in step across iPhone and Mac.
Reset the class table for just the current semester, and courses still missing a room get looked up again on refresh.
The grades page loads faster, and terms without a ranking yet show an estimated GPA.
Ticking off an assignment on Home updates the class table badge right away, and the time slider drags fine on clashing courses.
The Apple Watch library QR code now comes through your iPhone, so it stays fresh.

zh-TW.title: 2.0.1 更新內容
highlights: 課表的學期選單只會列出入學年以後的學期。
設定中的主題色現在也套用到圖示、圖書證倒數圈與歷年成績趨勢線。
選課系統目前開放的學期以選課清單為準，已退選的課不會再從 Moodle 被加回課表。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.1
highlights: The class table's semester menu only lists terms from your admission year onward.
Your theme colour now reaches icons, the library QR countdown ring and the GPA trend line.
The term the course-selection system is serving follows its enrolment list, so dropped courses no longer come back from Moodle.

zh-TW.title: 2.0.2 更新內容
highlights: 新增校方行事曆：學期起訖、假日與補課日一次看完，Mac 版也有。
課程的動態島改由伺服器啟動，App 沒開著也會準時出現。
在另一台裝置重置學期後，這台裝置會跟著清空並自動重新抓取。
課表看得到每一節的上下課時間，也可以固定顯示第 10 節與 A、B、C 節。
設定裡可以自訂並驗證 API 端點，並新增「檢查伺服器狀態」。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.2
highlights: A new Academic Calendar shows term dates, holidays and make-up days — on Mac too.
Live Activities for classes now start from the server, so a class shows up on time even when the app isn't open.
Reset a semester on one device and this one empties and refetches to match.
The class table shows each period's start and end time, and can always display periods 10, A, B and C.
Settings lets you set and validate a custom API endpoint, and adds a "Check Server Status" row.

zh-TW.title: 2.0.3 更新內容
highlights: 課表可以固定顯示全部節次，切換時會立刻重畫，晚間節次的時間也修正了。
動態島改用 App 圖示，課程結束後會顯示結束狀態，不再只是一個破折號。
小工具在單色模式下不再蓋上多餘的不透明底色。
TigerSync 會正確顯示在同步狀態與行事曆的同步來源中。
在圖書館畫面登入後，設定頁也會立刻看到登入狀態。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.3
highlights: The class table can pin every period, redraws the moment you toggle one, and the evening period times are corrected.
The Dynamic Island uses the app icon and names the end state when a class finishes, instead of showing a dash.
Widgets no longer paint an extra opaque background in single-colour rendering.
TigerSync shows correctly in sync status and among the calendar's sync sources.
Sign in on the Library screen and Settings sees it right away.

zh-TW.title: 2.1.0 更新內容
highlights: 作業提醒改由伺服器送出，App 沒開著也會準時提醒。
已經在 Moodle 繳交的作業，不會再提醒你交。
通知設定會跨裝置同步，在一台調整好，其他裝置就跟著更新。
Moodle 登入過期時，通知會說清楚發生什麼事，不再是一則空白橫幅。
預先排好的課程動態島不會再被 App 自己關掉。
關閉「同步課程資訊」後，本裝置將不再收到作業到期提醒。

en.title: What's new in 2.1.0
highlights: Assignment reminders now come from the server, so they arrive on time even when the app isn't open.
Assignments you have already submitted on Moodle stop reminding you.
Notification settings sync across your devices — change them on one and the rest follow.
When your Moodle login expires, the notification explains what happened instead of arriving blank.
Scheduled class Live Activities are no longer ended by the app itself.
Turning off "Sync course information" now also turns off assignment reminders on this device.

zh-TW.title: 2.1.1 更新內容
highlights: 修復跨系合開的課程無法關聯至 Moodle 的問題
修復跨系合開的課程無法顯示作業的問題
修復暑期課程的作業顯示問題

en.title: What's new in 2.1.1
highlights: Fixed cross-listed courses not linking to Moodle
Fixed assignments not showing for cross-listed courses
Fixed assignment display for summer-session courses

zh-TW.title: 2.1.2 更新內容
highlights: 可於設定中調整，是否於課表頁面顯示教室位置
課程詳情新增通識向度與課程期間
允許複製課程代碼
相容具有小數點學分

en.title: What's new in 2.1.2
highlights: The class table previews the classroom right in the course cell, and you can turn it off in Settings
Course details now show the GE dimension and the course duration
Tap a course code to copy it
Half-credit courses no longer count as zero — credit totals, the transcript and your GPA all include them

zh-TW.title: 2.1.3 更新內容
highlights: 相容於 iPhone Duo
可在 App 內查看所有開源授權
最佳化顯示頁面，螢幕左滑回到上一頁
最佳化圖書館 QR 顯示
修復同步後課程詳情遺失通識向度與課程期間的問題

en.title: What's new in 2.1.3
highlights: Compatible with iPhone Duo
View every open-source license right in the app
Optimized page display — swipe from the left edge to go back
Optimized the library QR code display
Fixed course details losing the GE dimension and course duration after a sync

zh-TW.title: 2.1.4 更新內容
highlights: 放假日不再跳出課程動態島
放假日的「今日課程」與首頁「時光機」不再列出當天的課
在行事曆切換「還要上課？」後，動態島、小工具與課表立即更新
臨時宣布的放假日（如颱風假），打開 App 即會收起已出現的課程動態島

en.title: What's new in 2.1.4
highlights: Class Live Activities no longer pop up on holidays
On holidays, Today's courses and the home Time machine no longer list that day's classes
Flipping “Still have class?” in the calendar updates the Live Activity, widgets and class table right away
For a holiday announced at short notice (such as a typhoon day), opening the app dismisses class Live Activities already on screen

zh-TW.title: 2.2.0 更新內容
highlights: 新增「即時」校園信箱：收發臺科大信件，收件匣、寄件備份、草稿、回收筒、廣告信等
可搜尋、回覆、全部回覆與轉寄信件，也能加入附件，或分享、儲存收到的附件

en.title: What's new in 2.2.0
highlights: New real-time School Mail: send and receive your NTUST mail — Inbox, Sent, Drafts, Trash, Junk and more
Search, reply, reply all and forward, add attachments, and share or save the ones you receive

items.title: Class reminder settings
items.body: Turn class reminders off or choose how early they come.

items.title: Ignore a course's assignments
items.body: Ignore all of a course's assignments and their due reminders.

items.title: Apple Watch complication
items.body: See your next class right on the watch face.

items.title: 空教室
items.body: 查詢今天起兩週內的空教室，兩堂課之間也會建議可以待的教室。

items.title: TAT 介面風格

items.title: 團隊作業的繳交狀態
items.body: 組員繳交團隊作業後，也會顯示為已繳交。

items.title: 問題修正
items.body: 修正多項問題，使用起來更穩定。

items.title: Free classrooms

items.title: TAT style
items.body: Choose TAT under Interface style in Settings for a grid class table.

items.title: Team assignments
items.body: A team assignment shows as submitted once a teammate submits it.

items.title: Fixes
items.body: Several fixes for a steadier app.

items.title: 問題修正
items.body: 修正課表、空教室、圖書館、信箱、同步與登入的多項問題。

items.title: Fixes
items.body: Fixes for the class table, free classrooms, Library, Mail, sync and sign-in.

items.title: 問題修正
items.body: 狀態點改為顯示上次更新時間，並修正同步、登入、信箱、公告與即時動態的多項問題。

items.title: Fixes
items.body: The status dot shows when each page was last updated, with fixes for sync, sign-in, Mail, bulletins and Live Activities.

items.title: 問題修正
items.body: 修正搜尋課程成員時的鍵盤問題。

items.title: Fixes
items.body: Fixes a keyboard issue when searching a course's members.

items.title: 作業頁
items.body: 點作業會在 App 內顯示說明、附件和繳交狀態，課程的 Moodle 區塊也新增作業列表。

items.title: 深色模式的信件
items.body: 深色模式下，信件文字的顏色會跟著調整，看得清楚。

items.title: 問題修正
items.body: 修正同步、信箱與背景更新的多項問題。

items.title: Assignment page
items.body: Tap an assignment to see its description, attachments and submission in the app, and find every assignment in a course's Moodle section.

items.title: Mail in dark mode
items.body: In dark mode, a message's text colours adapt so it stays readable.

items.title: Fixes
items.body: Fixes for sync, Mail and background updates.

items.title: 作業頁
items.body: 重新設計作業頁面。

items.title: 課程成員
items.body: 在成員名單中，將根據學號判斷並顯示系所、點擊頭像可進行預覽。

items.title: 改進與修正
items.body: Moodle 更新失敗提示文字、登出時的未同步資料提醒、修正 Moodle 內文圖片顯示問題。

items.title: Assignment page
items.body: A redesigned assignment page.

items.title: Course members
items.body: The members list shows each student's department from their student ID, and tapping a picture opens a preview.

items.title: Improvements and fixes
items.body: A note when a Moodle refresh fails, a reminder about unsynced data when you sign out, and a fix for images in Moodle text.

items.title: 時間顯示
items.body: 時間一律以 24 小時制顯示。

items.title: 手動加入的課程
items.body: 沒有網路時加入的課程，會在連線後自動上傳，同步時不再遺失。

items.title: 改進與修正
items.body: 修正巢狀過深的 Moodle 內文與信件可能造成閃退。

items.title: Time display
items.body: Times now always show on a 24-hour clock.

items.title: Added courses
items.body: A course added while offline uploads once you are back online, and a sync no longer drops it.

items.title: Improvements and fixes
items.body: A fix for a crash on deeply nested Moodle text and mail.

items.title: 自動登入
items.body: 自動登入被拒後會稍後再試，不再一直停在未登入。

items.title: Automatic sign-in
items.body: After a refused sign-in, automatic sign-in tries again later instead of stopping for good.

items.title: 帳號策略
items.body: 學校、信箱、與圖書館帳號各自完全獨立。

items.title: 三校聯盟
items.body: 在臺大、臺師大修的課現在也會出現在課表。

items.title: 改進與修正
items.body: 圖書館登入被拒後會稍後再試，並修正手動加入的課程、登出提醒與信件顯示的問題。

items.title: Account policy
items.body: School, mail and library accounts are now fully independent.

items.title: NTU System
items.body: Courses taken at NTU or NTNU now also show in the class table.

items.title: Improvements and fixes
items.body: Library sign-in tries again later after a refusal, with fixes for hand-added courses, the sign-out warning and mail display.

items.title: 作業延長
items.body: 老師給的延長會算進截止時間，首頁、行事曆與提醒都以延長後的時間為準。

items.title: 登出
items.body: 登出學校帳號時，會一併清除 App 內瀏覽器的資料。

items.title: 改進與修正
items.body: 修正作業頁切換作業、留言顯示與成績多餘小數點的問題。

items.title: Extensions
items.body: An extension from your teacher now sets the due date on Home, the calendar and reminders.

items.title: Signing out
items.body: Signing out of your school account also clears the in-app browser's data.

items.title: Improvements and fixes
items.body: Fixes for switching assignments, comments on the assignment page and extra decimals in grades.

items.title: 分享課表
items.body: 用相機掃描或點開分享連結，就能直接在 App 裡匯入課表。

items.title: 信箱勿擾
items.body: 可設定勿擾時段，及設定臺科公告欄、Moodle 繳交通知等郵件靜音。

items.title: 課程成員
items.body: 成員列表會標出自己，並可在 App 內更換大頭貼。

items.title: 改進與修正
items.body: 圖書館 QR Code 取得失敗時可立即重試，並修正從通知開啟公告與信件的問題。

items.title: Sharing class tables
items.body: Scan a shared code with the Camera or open its link to import the class table in the app.

items.title: Mail quiet hours
items.body: Set quiet hours and mute mail such as NTUST Bulletin Board and Moodle submission receipts.

items.title: Course members
items.body: The member list marks you, and you can change your profile picture in the app.

items.title: Improvements and fixes
items.body: Retry a library QR code right away after a failed request, with fixes for opening bulletins and mail from notifications.

items.title: 亮色模式
items.body: 「顏色主題」可選亮色或暗色模式，預設跟隨系統。

items.title: 自訂主題色
items.body: 主題色除了預設顏色，也能挑選任何顏色。

items.title: 首頁
items.body: 改進作業捲動的效果，並修正左右滑動的標記問題。

items.title: 改進與修正
items.body: 掃描匯入課表時可開手電筒或輸入連結，分享課表可複製連結，課表上的課名也更清楚。

items.title: Light mode
items.body: The app comes in light and dark, and follows the system by default.

items.title: Custom accent
items.body: Besides the presets, the accent can be any colour you pick.

items.title: Home
items.body: Assignments scroll more smoothly, with fixes to the swipe actions.

items.title: Improvements and fixes
items.body: The import scanner gains a flashlight and link entry, the share sheet copies its link, and course names on the class table read more clearly.

items.title: 安全連線
items.body: 網站憑證檢查，避免中間人攻擊。

items.title: 改進與修正
items.body: 將第三方端點改為 TigerDuck API 提供。

items.title: Secure connections
items.body: Website certificate checks guard against man-in-the-middle attacks.

items.title: Improvements and fixes
items.body: Third-party endpoints are now served by the TigerDuck API.

items.title: 行事曆
items.body: 修正行事曆節假日的顯示問題。

items.title: 改進與修正
items.body: 修正未完成作業的點擊問題。

items.title: Calendar
items.body: Fixes how holidays show in the calendar.

items.title: Improvements and fixes
items.body: Fixes tapping incomplete assignments.

items.title: 內建瀏覽器

items.title: 新增課程
items.body: 新增額外篩選器，可以用任何方式找到想要的課。

items.title: 學校信箱
items.body: 支援中文搜尋。

items.title: 改進與修正
items.body: 首頁編輯改為版面編輯，並改善登入、同步與大字級顯示。

items.title: In-app browser
items.body: We gave ourselves a hard time to sign you in automatically. More school systems will follow; for now it only edits your own Moodle profile.

items.title: Add Course
items.body: New filters let you find the course you want any way you like.

items.title: School Mail
items.body: Search now works in Chinese.

items.title: Improvements and fixes
items.body: Home's edit mode becomes a layout editor, with sign-in, sync and large text fixes.

items.title: 課程大綱
items.body: 直接在課表查看課程大綱。

items.title: 儲存空間
items.body: 在設定中查看快取的佔用情形。

items.title: 改進與修正
items.body: 過去學期的課表資料來源更換成歷年成績；Moodle 教材預設開啟本週；信箱顯示同步進度。

items.title: Syllabus
items.body: See a course's syllabus right in the class table.

items.title: Storage
items.body: See how much space the caches take up, in Settings.

items.title: Improvements and fixes

items.title: 學校信箱
items.body: 修正「所有郵件」的涵蓋範圍。

items.title: 改進與修正
items.body: 搜尋時立即同步並即時更新結果；切換信件匣時保留搜尋狀態。

items.title: School Mail
items.body: Fixed which folders All Mail covers.

items.title: Improvements and fixes
items.body: Search syncs right away and updates its results as it goes; switching folders keeps your search state.

items.title: 課程異動
items.body: 課表、首頁、Widget 與 Apple Watch 會顯示停課、換教室與時間異動。

items.title: 改進與修正
items.body: 修正部分 Moodle 成員名稱的顯示。

items.title: Course changes
items.body: The class table, Home, widgets and Apple Watch show cancelled classes and room and time changes.

items.title: Improvements and fixes
items.body: Fixed how some Moodle member names are shown.

items.title: 改進與修正
items.body: 修正登入後偶爾被登出、過時的課程通知、手動更新時忽略快取。

items.title: Improvements and fixes
items.body: Fixed an occasional sign-out after signing in and outdated class notifications, and manual refreshes now skip the cache.
